features: [Small in Size. Big on Power.]:Meet Numen 65C — the smallest 65W GaN charger designed to power everything from smartphones to laptops. Its ultra-compact form factor makes it easy to carry wherever you go, while delivering powerful, high-speed charging for all your everyday devices.

[Unlock Samsung's Fastest Charging Speeds]:Engineered to support Samsung Super Fast Charging 2.0 and 3.0, Numen 65C delivers optimal charging performance for compatible Galaxy devices. Spend less time plugged in and more time doing what matters.

[India's First AVS Compatible GaN Charger]:Built for the latest generation of devices, Numen 65C supports Adjustable Voltage Supply (AVS) technology, enabling faster and more efficient charging on compatible smartphones. Future-ready charging, packed into an incredibly compact charger.

[One Charger for Your Entire Tech Setup]:With up to 65W USB-C PD PPS output, Numen 65C can charge iPhones, Pixels, Samsung smartphones, tablets, accessories, and even laptops like the MacBook Air. Replace multiple chargers with one compact powerhouse.

[Made in India. Built to Last.]:Proudly Made in India and BIS certified, Numen 65C is designed with advanced safety protections against overheating, overcurrent, and short circuits. Reliable, efficient, and built for everyday use, wherever life takes you.
